objective: Review the Noetix endless moon-walk simulation evidence as one MoonClaw work packet before any stronger dynamics or hardware-authority claim.

inputs.summary: Moonrobo source model audit for Noetix URDF/profile metadata and missing collision/inertial tags.
Kinematic endless +x Noetix walk trace over Moonmoon terrain.
URDF-reference link-pose trace bound to the walk frames and contact probes.
Static COM/support report that explicitly remains review-only for dynamic walking.
Capture-point dynamic stability report that remains review-only without controller and inertia evidence.
Moonphys joint-control replay over Noetix gait phases and URDF joint limits.
Moonphys inertial/collision review report over Noetix mass assumptions, shape bounds, terrain collisions, and self-contact manifolds.
Rabbita playback for inspecting the walk and link-pose skeleton.

artifacts.producer: moon run cmd/main -- moonrobo noetix model json
artifacts.required_state: Moonrobo source model audit records URDF links, joints, visual geometry, joint limits, and missing inertial/collision tags
artifacts.current_state: 25 links; 24 joints; 6 visual geometries; collision tags 0; inertial tags 0

artifacts.producer: moon run cmd/main -- moonrobo noetix walk json
artifacts.required_state: endless +x Noetix trace with lunar gravity, contact probes, and joint phases

artifacts.producer: moon run cmd/main -- moonrobo noetix poses json
artifacts.required_state: URDF-reference link poses are present for each Noetix walk frame
artifacts.current_state: 32 frames; 25 links per frame; status review-only

artifacts.producer: moon run cmd/main -- moonrobo noetix stability json
artifacts.required_state: static support evidence is reviewed before any dynamic-walk or hardware claim
artifacts.current_state: 32/32 frames require support review; worst planar margin -0.035 m; status static-support-review
artifacts.blocking_reason: static COM support is review-only until dynamic stability, joint-control, inertia, and collision evidence clear

artifacts.producer: moon run cmd/main -- moonrobo noetix dynamics json
artifacts.required_state: capture-point dynamic stability evidence is reviewed before any stronger walking claim
artifacts.current_state: 32/32 frames require capture-point review; worst capture margin -0.035 m; status dynamic-stability-review
artifacts.blocking_reason: capture-point evidence is review-only until joint-control, inertia, and collision evidence clear

artifacts.producer: moon run cmd/main -- moonrobo noetix control json
artifacts.required_state: Moonphys joint servo replay checks the Noetix gait phases against URDF limits and actuator power/work accounting
artifacts.current_state: 32 frames; 24 joints per frame; saturated frames 0; limit-review frames 0; max power 19.39254212656542 W; absolute work 101.13118838556709 J; status joint-control-assumption-review
artifacts.blocking_reason: joint-control evidence is review-only until servo gains, inertia, and hardware authority are validated

artifacts.producer: moon run cmd/main -- moonrobo noetix collision json
artifacts.required_state: Moonphys diagonal inertia, collision bounds, terrain collisions, contact torque, and conservative self-collision manifolds are present for review
artifacts.current_state: 32 frames; 8 shapes per frame; self-contact review frames 32; terrain-review frames 0; status inertial-collision-self-review
artifacts.blocking_reason: inertial/collision evidence is review-only until Moonrobo provides authoritative mass, inertia, and collision tags

artifacts.required_state: Rabbita renders Noetix walk, link-pose skeleton, frame controls, and simulation-only authority
artifacts.current_state: Noetix panel consumes walk and link-pose JSON with skeleton playback

acceptance_criteria.description: Task links source model, walk, link poses, static support, dynamic stability, joint control, inertial/collision, and Rabbita playback evidence with concrete validation commands.
Source model audit records zero authoritative collision and inertial tags, keeping physics evidence in review.
Static support review frames remain explicit blockers for dynamic walking evidence.
Joint-control evidence remains review-only until servo gains, inertia, and hardware authority are validated.
Inertial/collision evidence remains review-only until authoritative Moonrobo mass, inertia, and collision tags are available.
MoonRobo hardware_state remains HardwareDenied and authority remains moonmoon-safety-gate-only.
Task names authoritative Moonrobo mass, inertia, and collision tags as the next requirement before stronger simulation claims.

safety_gate: Do not convert the Noetix source-model audit, walk trace, link poses, static support, dynamic stability, joint-control report, or inertial/collision report into hardware authority. Authoritative Moonrobo mass, inertia, and collision tags must replace assumptions before any claim beyond simulation review.
next_action: Use this task to review source-model, contact, link-pose, static-support, dynamic-stability, joint-control, and inertial/collision evidence; then replace assumed mass/collision metadata or keep hardware denied.
